missions.prompt: The PingMarket SMS buyer (cus_pm_sms_buyer) texted: "looking for a desk under $150 in Berkeley". Prepare an unpaid proposal for the best matching listing.
policy: Change only the records named in this mission and leave unrelated state unchanged.
Read the catalog and select only active, existing one-time USD prices. Do not create products or prices, and ignore inactive (stale) listing prices.
When several listings match, prefer the one matching the most words in the text, then the cheapest. The total must not exceed the texted budget.

Create one invoice item per selected price, then exactly one draft invoice for cus_pm_sms_buyer. Leave it unpaid and unfinalized; never attempt charges, payment intents, finalization or payment. The buyer pays later through PingMarket's Stripe Checkout link.
